tasks.title: The Cat sprite
tasks.description: Move the Cat sprite with the mouse: if the mouse pointer touches the Cat sprite and the mouse is held down, the sprite follows the mouse.

requirements.title: Controlling the Cat sprite
requirements.text: Use two nested conditions to check whether the mouse is down and the pointer touches the Cat. Move the Cat to the pointer when both are true.

requirements.title: Continuous condition checking
requirements.text: Put the checks inside a forever loop so the Cat keeps responding.

requirements.title: Another way to control the Cat sprite

requirements.title: Continuous condition checking

tasks.title: Cat and Hedgehog

requirements.title: Controlling the Cat sprite
requirements.text: Move the Cat to the pointer while the mouse is held down and the pointer touches the Cat.

requirements.title: Movement of Hedgehog sprites
requirements.text: Program the movement of both Hedgehog sprites.

requirements.title: Hedgehog sprite touching
requirements.text: Use OR to detect contact with either Hedgehog.

requirements.title: Continuous condition checking and initial placement
requirements.text: Set the starting positions and keep checking for contact as the game runs.

tasks.title: Growth apple
tasks.description: The Cat sprite isn't allowing the Triceratops sprite to reach the volcano. The dinosaur will only leave if the Cat sprite becomes large enough. To do that, it needs to touch the magic apple!

requirements.title: The Cat sprite grows in size when it touches the apple
requirements.text: Increase the Cat’s size by 20 when it touches the magic apple.

requirements.title: The Cat sprite shouldn't grow immediately
requirements.text: After each increase, wait until the Cat stops touching the apple before checking for another touch.
